name: 🌸 [OUTFIT] HALLYU EXPEDITION 🌸
desc:
Hi! Welcome to Hallyu Expedition 💫
Experience the journey of becoming an idol; from a humble trainee 🌱 to a legendary star 👑✨

🎶 Here’s what you’ll find inside:

* Beautiful and aesthetic title rank system 🌸
* Each stage features your favorite idols and biases ✨
* Pastel & pink mapthat feels cozy and dreamy 🌈
* Try on various outfits and poses made just for you ✨

💖 Bonus :
At every checkpoint, you can take photos with your favorite idols 🎤✨ — and who knows, there might be a little surprise waiting for you 👀💫

⚠️ K-Pop Alert!
This map is filled with idol posters.
If that’s not really your thing, feel free to skip this one 🌸💕
